concept.title: How work flows through Command Centre
concept.shortdesc: Every email, event or request becomes a task. Your assistant works on it, and anything outward-facing waits for you unless the business's policy says otherwise.

ol.li: Something comes in. An email, an Odoo order or helpdesk message, a social comment or DM, a schedule firing, or your own message in Chat or Converse.

It is sorted. Triage decides which business (DMS, 3dpandme, OpenV, OpenD, personal) and what kind of work it is: an order-status question, a supplier email, spam and so on. Spam and noise are filed without running an agent.

Your assistant takes it. Every task goes to the assistant, filed under the business triage picked. On work you started (chat, Converse, schedules) it can use every business's tools; on work from outside, only that business's. It reads the business's how-we-work note first, and hands only specialist work (a code change, a video, a blog post) to a specialist, which reports back to it. See Businesses.
An agent works on it. It reads the Brain, uses its skills and tools (Odoo, mail, calendar), and writes up what it did. You can follow every step in the task's Conversation.
It proposes actions. Sending an email, posting, changing a price or producing a video is a proposal.

The policy decides. Each proposal belongs to a business, and each business sets, per action type, one of three levels:
Waits for approvalThe default. It appears in Approvals and, if you allow it, as a push notification. Runs, listed in the digestIt runs straight away and is reported in the daily digest. Runs straight awayIt runs silently.

conbody.note: Work that started with an email, a webhook or any other outside message always waits for approval, whatever the policy says. Text from strangers is treated as information, never as instructions.

section.title: Spend and budgets
section.p: Every agent run is costed. The Inbox shows today's spend against the daily budget. When a budget is used up, new tasks are deferred and run after midnight, unless you choose Run now on one.

section.title: Worker PCs
section.p: Heavy jobs, such as rendering a video, go to a Windows PC running the desktop app. See Devices.
